options: Something that changes one form of energy into another
converter.hint: The answer is "Something that changes one form of energy into another". A converter changes energy from one form into another form.

converter.q: Which statement about converters is true?
options: A converter only works in the dark
converter.hint: The answer is "A toaster is a converter". A toaster changes electrical energy into heat, so it is a converter.

converter.q: Fill in the blank: A converter changes one ___ of energy into another.
converter.hint: The answer is "form". Converters change energy from one form into a different form.

converter.q: Which word means 'something that changes one form of energy into another'?
converter.hint: The answer is "converter". That is the meaning of the word converter.

converter.q: The study guide gives three examples of converters. Which group is it?
converter.hint: The answer is "solar panel, motor, toaster". A solar panel, a motor and a toaster each change one energy form into another.

converter.q: Which of these is a converter?
converter.hint: The answer is "a lamp". A lamp changes electrical energy into light.

converter.q: Which of these is NOT a converter?
converter.hint: The answer is "a wooden block". A wooden block does not change energy from one form into another.

converter.q: A blender, a hair dryer and a flashlight all belong in which group?
converter.hint: The answer is "converters". Each one changes energy from one form into another.

converter.q: Pick the item that belongs with a solar panel, a motor and a toaster.
converter.hint: The answer is "an electric fan". A fan is a converter: it changes electrical energy into motion.

converter.q: Which kitchen item is a converter?
converter.hint: The answer is "a microwave oven". A microwave oven changes electrical energy into heat for food.

converter.q: Mia plugs in a toaster and makes toast. What energy goes in and what comes out?
converter.hint: The answer is "Electrical in, heat out". A toaster changes electrical energy into heat.

converter.q: Leo's toy car runs on a motor. Why is the motor a converter?
options: It changes electrical energy into motion
converter.hint: The answer is "It changes electrical energy into motion". A motor changes electrical energy into motion energy.

converter.q: At the science fair, Ava shows a sun-powered calculator. Which part changes sunlight into electricity?
converter.hint: The answer is "the solar panel". The solar panel is the converter that changes light into electrical energy.

converter.q: Sam wants to change electrical energy into heat to warm his bread. Which converter should he use?
converter.hint: The answer is "a toaster". A toaster changes electrical energy into heat.

converter.q: When any converter changes energy into another form, what can you predict happens to some of the energy?
converter.hint: The answer is "Some becomes heat". Energy never goes away, and some always becomes heat.

options: Energy that comes only from coal
Energy that can only be used once
Energy from sources that are naturally refilled
renewable.hint: The answer is "Energy from sources that are naturally refilled". Renewable energy comes from sources that nature refills.

renewable.q: In the study guide, what does the word 'replenished' mean?
renewable.hint: The answer is "refilled". Replenished means refilled.

renewable.q: Fill in the blank: Sun, wind and flowing water are ___ energy sources.
renewable.hint: The answer is "renewable". Sun, wind and flowing water are naturally refilled, so they are renewable.

options: Wind is a renewable energy source
Coal is a renewable energy source
renewable.hint: The answer is "Wind is a renewable energy source". Wind is naturally replenished, so it is renewable.

renewable.q: Which term means energy from sources that refill naturally?
renewable.hint: The answer is "renewable energy". Renewable energy comes from sources that are naturally replenished.

renewable.q: Which of these is a renewable energy source?
renewable.hint: The answer is "sunlight". Sunlight is naturally replenished every day.

renewable.q: Which of these is NOT a renewable energy source?
renewable.hint: The answer is "natural gas". Natural gas is limited and cannot be replaced quickly.

renewable.q: Pick the one that belongs with sun and wind.
renewable.hint: The answer is "flowing water". Flowing water is renewable, just like sun and wind.

renewable.q: Which group has ONLY renewable sources?
renewable.hint: The answer is "sun, wind, flowing water". Sun, wind and flowing water are all naturally replenished.

renewable.q: Which of these is powered by a renewable source?
renewable.hint: The answer is "a windmill". A windmill uses wind, which is renewable.

renewable.q: Nora's town builds wind turbines on a hill. Why will the wind not run out?
options: Wind can be used only once
renewable.hint: The answer is "Wind is naturally replenished". Wind keeps coming back, so it is renewable.

renewable.q: A family puts solar panels on their roof. What kind of energy source are they using?
renewable.hint: The answer is "renewable". Sunlight is naturally replenished, so it is renewable.

renewable.q: In class, Jay sorts energy cards. Where does the card 'a river spinning a water wheel' go?
renewable.hint: The answer is "the renewable pile". Flowing water is a renewable energy source.

renewable.q: Kim says, 'If we use sunlight today, there will be none tomorrow.' What should you tell her?
options: The Sun keeps shining, so it is renewable
She is right, sunlight runs out
renewable.hint: The answer is "The Sun keeps shining, so it is renewable". Sunlight is naturally replenished, so it does not run out.

renewable.q: A camp wants power from a source that keeps refilling by itself. What should they choose?
options: a water wheel in a flowing stream
renewable.hint: The answer is "a water wheel in a flowing stream". Flowing water is renewable; gasoline and coal are not.

options: Energy from limited sources that cannot be replaced quickly
Energy that comes only from wind
Energy that refills itself every day
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "Energy from limited sources that cannot be replaced quickly". Nonrenewable sources are limited and cannot be replaced quickly.

options: Natural gas is the same as sunlight
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "Oil cannot be replaced quickly". Oil is a nonrenewable source, so it cannot be replaced quickly.

nonrenewable.q: Fill in the blank: Nonrenewable sources are ___ and cannot be replaced quickly.
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "limited". Nonrenewable sources are limited, so they can run out.

nonrenewable.q: Which term matches 'limited sources like coal and oil'?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "nonrenewable energy". Coal and oil are limited, so they are nonrenewable.

nonrenewable.q: Which list shows only nonrenewable sources?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "coal, oil, gasoline, natural gas". Coal, oil, gasoline and natural gas are limited and cannot be replaced quickly.

nonrenewable.q: Which of these is a nonrenewable source?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "coal". Coal is limited and cannot be replaced quickly.

nonrenewable.q: Which of these is NOT a nonrenewable source?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "flowing water". Flowing water is naturally replenished, so it is renewable.

nonrenewable.q: Pick the one that belongs with coal and oil.
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "natural gas". Natural gas is nonrenewable, like coal and oil.

nonrenewable.q: Which of these uses a nonrenewable source?
options: a car that runs on gasoline
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "a car that runs on gasoline". Gasoline is a nonrenewable source.

nonrenewable.q: Which fuel is pumped into cars at a gas station?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "gasoline". Gasoline is a nonrenewable source of energy.

nonrenewable.q: A town's coal mine is almost empty. Why can't they just wait for more coal?
options: Coal falls from the sky in rain
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "Coal cannot be replaced quickly". Coal is nonrenewable, so it cannot be replaced quickly.

nonrenewable.q: Ella's class asks, 'Why should we save oil?' What is the best answer?
options: Oil is made by the Sun each day
Oil is limited and can run out
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "Oil is limited and can run out". Oil is a limited, nonrenewable source.

nonrenewable.q: Ben's house is heated by burning natural gas. What kind of source is that?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "nonrenewable". Natural gas is limited and cannot be replaced quickly.

nonrenewable.q: A school wants to stop using a source that will run out. Which one should it stop using?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "coal". Coal is nonrenewable and can run out.

nonrenewable.q: At the science fair, Omar shows a jar of oil and a pinwheel spun by wind. Which is the nonrenewable source?
nonrenewable.hint: The answer is "the oil". Oil is nonrenewable; wind is renewable.

solar.q: Is solar energy renewable or nonrenewable?
options: renewable, because the Sun keeps shining
solar.hint: The answer is "renewable, because the Sun keeps shining". The Sun is a source that is naturally replenished.

solar.q: The word 'solar' has to do with what?
solar.hint: The answer is "the Sun". Solar means having to do with the Sun.

solar.q: Fill in the blank: Solar energy is energy that comes from the ___.
solar.hint: The answer is "Sun". Solar energy is energy that comes from the Sun.

options: The Sun gives us only sound
The Sun gives us light and heat
solar.hint: The answer is "The Sun gives us light and heat". The Sun is a source of both light and heat.

solar.q: Which term means energy that comes from the Sun?
solar.hint: The answer is "solar energy". Energy from the Sun is called solar energy.

solar.q: Which is an example of using solar energy?
solar.hint: The answer is "drying wet clothes in sunshine". Sunshine dries the clothes using energy from the Sun.

solar.q: Which is NOT using solar energy?
options: a solar panel on a roof
solar.hint: The answer is "a gasoline lawn mower". A gasoline mower uses gasoline, not energy from the Sun.

solar.q: Pick the one that gets its energy from the Sun.
solar.hint: The answer is "a solar garden light". A solar garden light gets its energy from sunlight.

solar.q: Which of these comes from solar energy?
options: the heat from a gas stove
the warmth of sand on a sunny beach
solar.hint: The answer is "the warmth of sand on a sunny beach". The Sun warms the beach sand.

solar.q: Which group uses ONLY solar energy?
options: solar calculator, lizard warming in the sun, sun-dried raisins
gas car, solar calculator, coal stove
solar.hint: The answer is "solar calculator, lizard warming in the sun, sun-dried raisins". All three in that group use energy from the Sun.

solar.q: Zoe leaves a chocolate bar on a sunny windowsill and it melts. Why?
options: A cold wind blew on it
The window made a loud sound
solar.hint: The answer is "Solar energy heated it". The Sun gives heat, and that heat melted the chocolate.

solar.q: A dark sidewalk feels hot on a summer afternoon. Where did the heat come from?
solar.hint: The answer is "the Sun". The Sun is a source of heat.

solar.q: Max wants to cook a hot dog at camp with no fuel and no electricity. What can he use?
options: a solar oven box lined with foil
solar.hint: The answer is "a solar oven box lined with foil". A solar oven uses energy from the Sun.

solar.q: In class, one plant sits in sunlight and one sits in a dark closet. Which plant gets solar energy?
solar.hint: The answer is "the plant in the sunlight". Solar energy comes from the Sun, so only the plant in sunlight gets it.

solar.q: On a very cloudy day, what would you predict about the sunlight reaching a solar garden light?
solar.hint: The answer is "Less sunlight reaches it". Clouds block some of the Sun's light.

solarpanel.q: What does a solar panel do?
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "Converts sunlight into electrical energy". A solar panel changes light energy into electrical energy.

options: A solar panel is a converter
A solar panel turns electricity into wind
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "A solar panel is a converter". A solar panel changes one form of energy into another.

solarpanel.q: What energy comes out of a solar panel?
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "electrical energy". A solar panel makes electrical energy.

solarpanel.q: Fill in the blank: A solar panel converts ___ into electrical energy.
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "sunlight". A solar panel changes sunlight (light energy) into electrical energy.

solarpanel.q: Which device converts sunlight into electrical energy?
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "a solar panel". That is exactly the job of a solar panel.

solarpanel.q: Which of these uses a solar panel?
options: a calculator that works in sunlight
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "a calculator that works in sunlight". A sun-powered calculator has a small solar panel.

solarpanel.q: Which is NOT an example of a solar panel at work?
options: solar roof tiles powering a house
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "a gas-powered car". A gas-powered car runs on gasoline, not sunlight.

solarpanel.q: Pick the one that belongs with solar calculators and solar garden lights.
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "a solar-powered road sign". A solar road sign also changes sunlight into electricity.

solarpanel.q: Which group of devices ALL make electrical energy from sunlight?
options: solar roof, solar calculator, solar garden light
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "solar roof, solar calculator, solar garden light". Each of those uses a solar panel to change light into electricity.

solarpanel.q: Which item could charge a phone using sunlight?
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "a solar charger". A solar charger has a solar panel that makes electricity from sunlight.

solarpanel.q: Lily keeps a solar garden light in a dark shed for a week. What happens?
options: It turns the dark into light
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "It cannot make electricity". With no sunlight, the solar panel cannot make electrical energy.

solarpanel.q: Owen's solar calculator stops when he covers the panel with his thumb. Why?
options: The calculator ran out of gasoline
His thumb added too much electricity
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "No light reaches the panel". A solar panel needs light to make electrical energy.

solarpanel.q: A family wants to add solar panels to their home. Where should they put them?
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "on a sunny roof". Solar panels need sunlight to work.

solarpanel.q: At the science fair, Ruby holds a solar panel connected to a small fan in the sunlight. What goes into the panel and what comes out?
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "Light in, electrical out". A solar panel changes light energy into electrical energy.

solarpanel.q: Why is a solar panel a good choice for a renewable energy project?
options: It uses sunlight, which is replenished
solarpanel.hint: The answer is "It uses sunlight, which is replenished". Sunlight is naturally replenished, so it is renewable.

options: A machine that makes wind from coal
A machine that uses wind to make electrical energy
turbine.hint: The answer is "A machine that uses wind to make electrical energy". A wind turbine uses wind to produce electrical energy.

turbine.q: What does a wind turbine need in order to work?
turbine.hint: The answer is "wind". A wind turbine uses wind to make electricity.

turbine.q: Fill in the blank: A wind turbine uses wind to produce ___ energy.
turbine.hint: The answer is "electrical". A wind turbine makes electrical energy.

options: A wind turbine uses a renewable source
A wind turbine works best with no wind
turbine.hint: The answer is "A wind turbine uses a renewable source". Wind is naturally replenished, so it is renewable.

turbine.q: Which machine uses wind to produce electrical energy?
turbine.hint: The answer is "a wind turbine". That is the job of a wind turbine.

turbine.q: Which of these belongs in the group 'things that make electrical energy'?
turbine.hint: The answer is "a wind turbine". A wind turbine makes electrical energy from wind.

turbine.q: Which part of a wind turbine does the wind push?
turbine.hint: The answer is "the blades". The wind pushes the blades and makes them spin.

turbine.q: Which machine also uses a renewable source, like a wind turbine?
turbine.hint: The answer is "a solar panel". A solar panel uses sunlight, which is renewable.

turbine.q: A wind farm is a big group of many ___.
turbine.hint: The answer is "wind turbines". A wind farm has many wind turbines making electricity.

turbine.q: Which kind of weather gives a wind turbine the most to work with?
turbine.hint: The answer is "a strong, steady breeze". A wind turbine uses wind, so a strong breeze helps most.

turbine.q: On a calm day with no wind at all, what happens to a wind turbine?
options: It makes little or no electricity
turbine.hint: The answer is "It makes little or no electricity". With no wind, the turbine cannot produce electrical energy.

turbine.q: Grace's town has windy days most of the year. Why might the town build wind turbines?
options: Wind can make electricity and will not run out
Wind turbines burn the wind as fuel
turbine.hint: The answer is "Wind can make electricity and will not run out". Wind turbines use wind, a renewable source, to make electrical energy.

turbine.q: In class, Jack blows on a tiny model turbine and a small light turns on. What did his breath act as?
turbine.hint: The answer is "the wind". His breath was moving air, just like wind.

turbine.q: Tara watches a wind turbine spinning near a farm. What goes into it and what comes out?
turbine.hint: The answer is "Moving wind in, electrical out". A wind turbine uses wind to produce electrical energy.

turbine.q: Which spot should a town pick for a new wind turbine?
turbine.hint: The answer is "an open, windy hilltop". A wind turbine needs lots of wind to work.

options: A device that converts motion energy into electrical energy
A device that converts electrical energy into motion energy
generator.hint: The answer is "A device that converts motion energy into electrical energy". A generator changes motion energy into electrical energy.

generator.q: What energy goes into a generator?
generator.hint: The answer is "motion energy". A generator needs motion to make electricity.

generator.q: What energy comes out of a generator?
generator.hint: The answer is "electrical energy". A generator makes electrical energy.

options: A generator works without anything moving
A generator turns electricity into motion
A generator does the opposite of a motor
generator.hint: The answer is "A generator does the opposite of a motor". A generator turns motion into electricity; a motor turns electricity into motion.

generator.q: Which device converts motion energy into electrical energy?
generator.hint: The answer is "a generator". That is the job of a generator.

generator.q: Which is an example of a generator at work?
options: a bike light powered by the turning wheel
generator.hint: The answer is "a bike light powered by the turning wheel". The turning wheel's motion is changed into electrical energy.

generator.q: Which of these is NOT a generator?
generator.hint: The answer is "an electric fan". A fan uses electricity to make motion, so it is a motor, not a generator.

generator.q: Pick the one that belongs with a hand-crank flashlight and a wheel-powered bike light.
generator.hint: The answer is "a hand-crank radio". All three use motion to make electrical energy.

generator.q: A wind turbine has a generator inside. What makes that generator spin?
generator.hint: The answer is "blades turned by the wind". The wind turns the blades, and that motion spins the generator.

generator.q: Which group shows motion being turned into electricity?
options: plugging in a fan, toasting bread
lighting a candle, ringing a bell
cranking a radio, pedaling a bike light
generator.hint: The answer is "cranking a radio, pedaling a bike light". Cranking and pedaling are motion that a generator changes into electrical energy.

generator.q: During a power outage, Eli cranks a hand-crank flashlight. What goes in and what comes out of the generator inside?
generator.hint: The answer is "Motion in, electrical out". A generator changes motion energy into electrical energy.

generator.q: Hana's bike light is powered by her turning wheel. Why does it go dark when she stops?
options: Pedaling uses up all the light
No motion means no electrical energy
generator.hint: The answer is "No motion means no electrical energy". A generator needs motion to make electricity.

generator.q: At the science fair, Noah spins a magnet inside a coil of wire and a tiny bulb glows. What did he build?
generator.hint: The answer is "a generator". He used motion to make electrical energy, which is what a generator does.

generator.q: Rushing water at a dam spins a machine that makes electricity for a city. What is that machine?
generator.hint: The answer is "a generator". The motion of the water is changed into electrical energy by a generator.

generator.q: Predict: what happens if you crank a hand-crank radio faster?
generator.hint: The answer is "It makes more electrical energy". More motion going in means more electrical energy coming out.

options: A device that converts motion energy into electrical energy
A device that converts electrical energy into motion energy
motor.hint: The answer is "A device that converts electrical energy into motion energy". A motor changes electrical energy into motion energy.

motor.q: What energy goes into a motor?
motor.hint: The answer is "electrical energy". A motor needs electrical energy to work.

motor.q: What useful energy comes out of a motor?
motor.hint: The answer is "motion energy". A motor makes things move.

options: A motor makes energy from nothing
A motor turns motion into electricity
motor.hint: The answer is "A motor is a converter". A motor changes electrical energy into another form, motion.

motor.q: Which device converts electrical energy into motion energy?
motor.hint: The answer is "a motor". That is the job of a motor.

motor.q: Which of these has a motor inside?
motor.hint: The answer is "an electric fan". A fan's motor changes electrical energy into spinning motion.

motor.q: Which of these does NOT use a motor?
motor.hint: The answer is "a candle". A candle does not change electrical energy into motion.

motor.q: Pick the one that belongs with a blender and an electric fan.
motor.hint: The answer is "a remote-control car". A remote-control car uses a motor, like a blender and a fan.

motor.q: Which is an example of a motor changing electrical energy into motion?
options: a battery toy train rolling on its track
motor.hint: The answer is "a battery toy train rolling on its track". The toy train's motor uses electricity to make the wheels move.
The answer is "hair dryer, blender, electric fan". Each of those uses a motor to make something spin.

motor.q: Ivy turns on an electric fan. What goes into its motor and what comes out?
motor.hint: The answer is "Electrical in, motion out". A motor changes electrical energy into motion energy.

motor.q: Carlos's remote-control car stops when its batteries die. Why?
options: The wheels ran out of sunlight
The motor gets no electrical energy
The motor got too much motion
motor.hint: The answer is "The motor gets no electrical energy". A motor needs electrical energy to make motion.

motor.q: For the science fair, Mila wants a paper propeller to spin using a battery. What should she use?
motor.hint: The answer is "a small motor". A motor turns electrical energy into motion.

motor.q: A blender's blades spin to make a smoothie. What part makes them spin?
motor.hint: The answer is "the motor". The motor changes electrical energy into the blades' motion.

motor.q: Predict: a toy car's motor gets weak, old batteries. Then you add fresh batteries. What happens?
motor.hint: The answer is "The wheels spin faster". More electrical energy into the motor gives more motion.
